criteria.description: Vocalization (Tashkīl) fidelity, orthographic integrity, and collation against authoritative manuscript witnesses.
Takhrīj of ḥadīth citations, cross-referencing of classical commentaries (ḥawāshī), and bibliographic traceability.
Alignment with mainstream Sunni scholarly orthodoxy (Ahl al-Sunnah wa-al-Jamāʿah) and authoritative creed texts.
Two-color or high-contrast ink clarity, chamois/ivory paper weight, binding durability, and margin proportions.
Critical apparatus, punctuation, paragraph segmentation, and pedagogical diagrams/indices.
